title: GoldenCoveMC
description: A Community Minecraft Server To Build Your Ideas
body:
GoldenCoveMC is a community Minecraft server created by kilim81 to allow friends, viewers, and anyone to play on a server with their friends in a vanilla fashion. The only requirement is that you must join the Discord server to link your Discord to your MC account

(This isn't a proper link; you just have to give the Discord bot the code you get from the server when attempting to join, and it will register that User221 playing Minecraft is discord user user771.)
**This is done to ensure bans and timeouts can be properly given.**

# **Some Stuff About Server**

1. **RTP** to take you anywhere within the 20k world border(will change world border size in a year)
2. **ECONOMY**, we have our own leader boards for richest players, a shop, and an auction system!
3. **Claims**, we have claims to make sure your stuff remains protected. Grifing is also not allowed.
4. **Leveled Mobs**, all mobs you face are stronger than normal. This adds a nice challenge to the game!
5. **Pets**, allows you to monitor your pets, and in the worst-case scenario, revive them with a nether star!
6. **TPA and homes**, your home and friends are never to far away!

and much more!
